terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Next.js dev server on http://localhost:3000 in mock/demo mode (ENABLE_MOCKS=true). External services (Postgres, Auth0, Gemini, Stripe, Vercel Blob) are mocked, so no real credentials are needed. To use real services instead, create a .env.local from .env.example and run 'npm run dev' without ENABLE_MOCKS.
